Card Q&A.a: Yes, you gain 2 memory if both of the conditions are met.
Card Q&A.q: Do I gain 2 memory for this card’s [Start of Your Turn] effect if both me and my opponent have a suspended Digimon?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have a suspended Digimon in play, gain 1 memory. If your opponent has a suspended Digimon in play, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When one of your green or blue Digimon deletes an opponent’s Digimon in battle and survives, you may suspend this Tamer to ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.
